sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a strong matchup on paper for the league leaders, as Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form with only one win in their last five games. Sandbach themselves have recovered well from a recent loss, having won three of their five most recent outings before that defeat.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stern test against struggling Dawley Town at home on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what shapes as a competitive clash between mid-table contenders, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals travel to face Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, occupying sixth place, host Foley Meir in a fixture between teams separated by just six points. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a match pitting mid-table against a side enduring a five-game losing streak. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half encounter, while Brereton Social host Widnes Town (Widnes having won just twice all season). Cheadle Heath Nomads face a tough away trip to Telford Town, and Crewe host Allscott Heath. Midweek, Brereton Social travel to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
